task_grid=[[5,7,5,5,7,5,5,7,7,7,7,5,7,7,2,0,5,0,5,0,5,0,0,0,0,5,0,5,5],[5,7,7,5,5,5,7,7,5,5,7,7,7,5,2,5,5,5,5,5,5,0,5,0,0,0,5,0,5],[5,7,5,5,7,5,7,5,7,7,5,5,5,7,2,0,5,0,0,0,5,5,5,0,5,5,0,0,0],[7,7,5,7,7,5,7,7,7,5,5,7,5,7,2,0,5,5,5,5,5,0,5,5,0,0,5,5,0]]
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    split = None
    for c in range(1, w - 1):
        if w == 2 * c + 1 and all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid):
            split = ("v", c)
            break
    if split is None:
        for r in range(1, h - 1):
            if h == 2 * r + 1 and all(value == grid[r][0] for value in grid[r]):
                split = ("h", r)
                break
    if split is None:
        raise ValueError("No centered divider found")
    axis, index = split
    if axis == "v":
        left = [row[:index] for row in grid]
        right = [row[index + 1:] for row in grid]
    else:
        left = grid[:index]
        right = grid[index + 1:]
    common = set(value for row in left for value in row) & set(value for row in right for value in row)
    fill = min(common, key=lambda color: sum(cell == color for row in left + right for cell in row))
    return [[3 if a == b else fill for arow, brow in zip(left, right) for a, b in zip(arow, brow)]] if axis == "v" else [[3 if a == b else fill for a, b in zip(arow, brow)] for arow, brow in zip(left, right)]
'''
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),globals())
ans=transform(task_grid)
print('dims',len(ans),len(ans[0]))
print(*ans,sep='\n')
